title: Size of the unrolled circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a sequential Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs, and let its size be the number of registers plus the number of gates in its combinational part. For every nonnegative integer $T$, the size of its unrolling through time $T$ is $n+(T+1)$ times the size of $M$.
